What's new in Stream Deck 7.6.1?

🛠️ Improvements & bug fixes
- Updated third-party components with the latest security fixes.
- Fixed a crash that could occur when a Stream Deck device was being initialized.
- Fixed a crash that could occur when starting a Node.js plugin whose manifest had a missing or malformed Node.js section.
- Fixed an issue where linked titles weren’t applied correctly to an action’s second state.
- Fixed an issue where reordered plugin categories reverted to their previous order after restarting Stream Deck.
- (Windows) Reworked hotkey handling so hotkeys work again in applications running with administrator privileges, including many fullscreen games.
- (Windows) Fixed a rare crash that could occur while Stream Deck was scanning for installed applications.
- (Windows) Fixed an issue where the Digital Time action could show the wrong time in some recently added timezones.
- (macOS) Fixed a crash on macOS 27 that could occur when quitting Stream Deck during log out, restart or shutdown.
Updating from an earlier version? Everything that came with Stream Deck 7.6 follows below.

What's new in Stream Deck 7.6?

🎛️ Infobar Actions for Stream Deck Neo
The Infobar is now a place you can put things. Drag an action onto it the way you would onto a key, and it shows live information while you work.
- See what’s playing on Spotify without touching your phone.
- See your CPU and GPU stats without opening another app with SimpleStats.
- Know the moment your AI agent needs you, even when you're looking at another screen, with ChatGPT & Codex.
- See today’s forecast and air quality before you head out the door with Weather.
Building your own plugin? SDK 3.0 now lets Makers add Infobar support for Stream Deck Neo. See the SDK docs for details.

🎵 All-New Spotify Plugin
The Spotify plugin has been rebuilt on Spotify’s official Web API. You get new actions for your library, playlists, search, and queue, plus a Now Playing view on the Stream Deck Neo Infobar.
Get Spotify
All of the new actions built on Spotify’s Web API require signing in with a Spotify Premium account.

🤖 ChatGPT & Codex Plugin
A new plugin brings OpenAI’s ChatGPT desktop app to Stream Deck, turning it into a dedicated physical surface for your agent. Send prompts, switch models, and run skills from a key or dial, and the Neo Infobar shows what your agent is doing so you always know the moment it needs you.
Get ChatGPT & Codex

🛠️ Improvements & bug fixes
- Fixed an issue where the app did not always start when set to launch automatically.
- (Windows) Fixed an issue, introduced in version 7.5.1, where some items like images could not be dragged from File Explorer into the app and some plugins could not interact with the app.
- The background library now includes backgrounds sized for the Stream Deck Neo Infobar.
- The Website action now updates its icon whenever the URL changes.
- Fixed an issue where Stream Deck Network Dock could disconnect at random.
- (macOS) Fixed an issue where clicking the menu bar item could crash the app on macOS 27.
- (Windows) Fixed an error message that appeared in the installer when fully uninstalling the app.
- (Windows) Reduced a periodic spike in system load caused by the scan for installed applications.

What’s new in Stream Deck 7.5?

🖱️ Introducing CORSAIR NIGHTSWORD v2
The NIGHTSWORD v2 WIRELESS SD is the first gaming mouse with a dedicated Stream Deck Launch Button. Launch your favorite game, access your go-to tools and take command of your setup with infinite options, always one button away.
🔗 Discover NIGHTSWORD v2

Improvements & bug fixes
- This update includes a firmware update for Galleon 100 SD, with stability and performance improvements.
- Stream Deck now only claims the keys on certain connected CORSAIR devices that have actions assigned to them. Keys without a Stream Deck action remain available for CORSAIR software to handle as intended.
- When importing a profile, Stream Deck now clearly distinguishes when a required plugin version isn’t available on Marketplace — rather than showing a generic error message.
- Resolved an issue where NIGHTSWORD v2 would stop appearing in Stream Deck after waking from sleep.
- Resolved an issue where a NIGHTSWORD v2 could lose its Stream Deck connection when switching between wireless and wired modes.
- (macOS) Resolved an issue where the “Open automatically at login” checkbox in Preferences could appear enabled even when macOS had blocked the app from launching at login.

What's new in Stream Deck 7.4.1?

AI Tools, Meet Stream Deck
Stream Deck now supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP), letting AI tools connect and trigger designated actions. NVIDIA Project G-Assist, the on-device AI assistant for GeForce RTX PCs, is the first to connect — and it brings something entirely new to Stream Deck: voice control. For the first time, you can trigger your actions just by speaking.

Watch how to set up G-Assist with Stream Deck
Learn more about integrating your AI Tools with Stream Deck.
*NVIDIA G-Assist requires GeForce RTX GPU with at least 6GB VRAM.

Improvements and bug fixes
- Improved account sign-in behavior to address an issue where account authentication windows would pop up repeatedly in your browser — the app will no longer automatically open your browser to prompt for Twitch, YouTube, or other account logins.
- Updated CORSAIR Galleon 100 SD firmware (3.06.005), which resolves a display issue affecting some units. The update is applied automatically when your device connects.
- (macOS) Updated default profiles for Galleon 100 SD and Stream Deck + XL.
- (Windows) Fixed an issue where the Toggle Virtual Stream Deck key could appear visually stuck after the interface was reopened. Functionality was not affected.
- (macOS) Fixed an issue where the Open Application action didn't display third-party apps in the dropdown list.
- Fixed a bug where nested Switch Profile actions inside a Multi Action could lose their internal references when imported.
- Fixed an issue where Key Logic displayed an overwrite confirmation when pasting into an empty key.
- Fixed an issue where the previous/next button indicators on Stream Deck Neo appeared black instead of reflecting the info bar color.

You asked for more inputs. So we pulled some levers to make it happen.

What's new in Stream Deck 7.3.1?
Introducing Stream Deck + XL
Our biggest Stream Deck yet. Stream Deck + XL brings 36 LCD keys and 6 dials to the full Stream Deck + experience — more room to build, more controls at your fingertips, and all the tactile, real-time precision Stream Deck + is known for.
Discover Stream Deck + XL

🎙️ Introducing Wave Next — The future of creator audio starts here
Wave Link 3.0 is the software backbone of Wave Next — built from the ground up to unlock everything the Wave FX Processor makes possible. Whether you're setting up the Wave:3 MK.2, Wave XLR MK.2, XLR Dock MK.2, or the all-new Wave XLR Pro, Wave Link 3.0 gives you full control over your hardware's Clipguard 2.0 protection, onboard DSP effects, , and VST Insert capabilities — all from one place.
Pair that with a Stream Deck + XL and you've got hands-on control over your entire audio setup without ever leaving your workflow.
Discover Wave Next
Watch the Wave Next announcement

Meet the all new Wave Link 3.0 plugin
Shape your sound from Stream Deck with the Wave Link plugin. Built for Wave Link 3.0, this plugin puts full control of your audio mix at your fingertips — adjust volume, mute inputs, trigger effects, and switch between mixes in real time using keys or dials. This release brings overhauled visuals, a new press-and-hold mode for effects — perfect for momentary triggers like a voice changer — plus fading with an option for smooth level transitions. Add to Stream Deck lets you generate a ready-made Wave Link profile for your device in one click, and under-the-hood improvements deliver faster level meters, a more reliable connection process, and numerous bug fixes.
👉 Get the Wave Link 3.0 plugin
Requires Wave Link 3.0 and is not backwards compatible with Wave Link 2.0

​ Performance improvements & bug fixes
- Fixed an issue where installing plugins via in-app search or the missing plugins dialog failed on the first attempt. Plugins from Marketplace will now install correctly straight away.
- Fixed an issue where Galleon 100 SD sporadically returned to hardware mode. Your Galleon 100 SD will now stay reliably connected to the Stream Deck app.
- Improved Smart Profile detection for games running in Borderless Windowed mode. Profiles will now switch correctly when alt-tabbing in and out of borderless windowed games.
- Fixed an issue where auto-installed profiles from plugins couldn't be switched to another profile from within the plugin.
- Fixed an issue where copying a page multiple times failed to carry over nested folders.
- Fixed an issue where the Auto Software Detection back-to-profile action could leave stale icons on screen instead of returning to the previous profile.
- Fixed a crash that could occur when triggering navigation actions inside a Key Logic action.
- Fixed a crash when a plugin monitoring applications was reloaded via deep-link.
- Fixed a number of crashes and issues related to app shutdown, plugin shutdown, and system log-off. (Windows)
- Fixed a crash that could occur with the Website action due to a file path conversion issue. (Windows)
- Fixed an issue where Discord plugin could not authorize with Discord app.
- Fixed an issue where opening Discord via Open Application action failed. (Windows)

What’s new in Stream Deck 7.1.1?
i
If the update fails to install, please download it from http://elgato.com/download.

🔎 In-App Marketplace Search
Plugins enable new and powerful features for your Stream Deck, and we want to make the experience of finding and quickly using them easier. In Stream Deck 7.1, you can now browse recommended plugins and search for plugins right inside the action list.
Once you’re signed in with your Marketplace account, installing plugins takes just one click.

🖼️ Refreshed Desktop Icon
We’re updating icons across all Elgato apps, and Stream Deck now refined look with color on both Windows and macOS.

💾 Profiles save more resources
Profiles in Stream Deck are incredibly powerful, making it easy to share complete configurations. However, they’re limited to sharing just the icon and key layout. With Stream Deck 7.0, profiles now tell you which plugins you’ll need when importing a profile, and you can install them with one click. Further improving the workflow, profiles exported with Stream Deck 7.1 now include files such as music that have been configured in an action.
Makers, your plugin can now contain custom resources which are included in profiles exported with Stream Deck 7.1. Learn more in our Maker Docs.

⛔ Disable Stream Deck Devices
Stream Deck devices can now be disabled in the Stream Deck app. This enables third-party software, such as Bitfocus Buttons and other applications, to communicate directly with Stream Deck devices. At the same time, the Stream Deck app can now remain open to support other Stream Deck hardware, Virtual Stream Deck or Stream Deck Mobile.
You’ll find the option in Preferences > Devices > Enabled (Yes/No)

🔁 NodeJS Sideloading
Developers, this one's for you. Stream Deck now automatically downloads and updates only the specific Node.js versions needed by your plugins—reducing the app’s size and ensuring you always have the right tools for your plugins. The version of Node.js required can be configured in your plugin’s manifest file.

Improvements & bug fixes
- The Volume Controller plugin is no longer bundled by default. When setting up Stream Deck for the first time, the default profile will notify that the plugin is missing, and you can optionally install it, or not.
- Stream Deck Network Dock firmware can now be updated via the Stream Deck app.
- Improvements were made to Smart Profiles and switching when games are running in Borderless Windowed mode. If Smart Profiles do not detect a game you are playing, please get in touch with our support team so we can collect more information.
- Improved macOS 26 compatibility, and progress bars now appear again, for example, when downloading an update.
- Resolved a bug that was preventing profile importing
- Resolved a bug that could cause a crash when importing a profile
- When switching between pages with many Open Application actions, Stream Deck will no longer temporarily freeze
- Fixed a bug where installing Stream Deck would stop due to a missing MSVCP140.dll file.

What’s new in Stream Deck 7.0.3?
This update adds support for Virtual Stream Deck, Network Dock, Key Logic, and much more.

🎛️ Virtual Stream Deck — your on-screen workspace controller
Create unlimited virtual keys, customize actions and layouts, then pin them in place or summon to your cursor. It’s your OS sidekick, making every workflow fast and effortless. It's Stream Deck on your computer, anywhere you go.

To start using Virtual Stream Deck today, update to Stream Deck 7.0 and create a new virtual device in the device dropdown.
Learn how to unlock Virtual Stream Deck.

👇 Key Logic — multi-tap abilities
Assign up to three different actions to a single key using Key Logic. Perform a unique action based on how the key is pressed:
- Press
- Double press
- Press and hold
For example, press to play/pause music, double press to skip tracks, or press and hold to go to the previous track.
To add Key Logic, right-click any key or drag it from the Multi Action category.

Tap in and learn more.

⛅ Weather plugin - stay ahead of the forecast
The new Weather Plugin for Stream Deck puts live weather updates and forecasts at your fingertips, with minimal setup and configuration. Instantly see the sky’s latest mood and plan your day without ever picking up your phone or opening a browser.
Get Weather on Elgato Marketplace.

⌨️ Improved system shortcuts — hotkey presets
The hotkey action has been updated with commonly used shortcuts, now available without needing to specify the exact hotkey. Select from copy, paste, screenshot and more.

🆕 Network Dock support
Network Dock is now available. You can add PoE connectivity to your existing Stream Deck. Streamline your setup with a single Ethernet cable. Power and data, all in one.

⚙️ How to add Network Dock:
When adding Network Dock, Stream Deck will automatically scan your network for available devices. You can also add it manually via IP address.
1. Click the device list in the top left.
2. Select Add Network Device…

🛠️ Improvements and bug fixes
- The Open Application action now displays a green dot when the selected app is running.
- You can now configure the Open Application action to either do nothing, close, or force quit the selected app when long-pressed.
- Fixed an issue where the the Open Application action ignored desktop shortcuts with arguments—for example, launching a specific Chrome profile.
- Fixed an issue where the Website action would send a GET request upon entering a URL, even without triggering the action.
- When importing a profile with multiple Stream Deck devices, the current device is now automatically selected in the dropdown.
- Device list in the profile import window is now sorted alphabetically.
- Fixed an issue where cancelling a profile import would block future imports until Stream Deck was restarted.
- Improved detection speed for connected Stream Deck devices when launching the software.
- Fixed an issue where hidden icon packs would still appear in the icon library.
- Added support for OBS Studio 32.
- When pressing an action where the plugin is missing (❓ icon), Stream Deck software will now prompt you to download the plugin from Marketplace.
- Fixed an issue where the Stream Deck Neo Infobar briefly reset the time to 00:00 after switching pages.
- Fixed an issue where certain plugins, like Apple Music and Spotify, did not work as expected.
- Plugin Makers and Developers: view the latest Stream Deck SDK changes on docs.elgato.com

What’s new in Stream Deck 6.9?
Plenty. This update brings smarter ways to open apps, paste text, and lots more—plus a fresh layer of quality-of-life improvements.
Let’s dive in.

The minimum requirements for operating systems are changing with this release.
- macOS 11 Big Sur → macOS 13 Ventura.
- Windows 10 → Windows 11.
Microsoft is ending support for Windows 10 in October 2025. Stream Deck should continue to work on Windows 10, however, we cannot guarantee full functionality.

🆕 Open App - From launch to close, all on one key
Launching your favorite apps just got easier. The new Open Application action shows a searchable list of installed programs—no file path hunting required.
And it now works with Windows Store (UWP) apps like Discord, Spotify, and Microsoft Teams.
✨ Pro tip: Press and hold the key to close the app. Quick in, quick out.

📝 Text Action – Now with Clipboard Paste Mode
The Text action now includes paste mode selection with options for simulating typing or pasting from clipboard. Simulate typing is exactly that—its as if you're typing the text. Paste from Clipboard is new and text is pasted as if you’ve pressed CTRL/CMD+V. The default mode has been changed to Paste from Clipboard.
- Simulate Typing is useful for programs that need inputs, like typing out commands in sim games
- Paste from Clipboard is useful for chat applications, when you want to paste a block of text as a single message

🌐 Website Action – Choose Your Browser
Now you can choose exactly where your Website actions open. Chrome for work, Firefox for dev, Safari for testing—it’s all up to you.
Just pick from your installed browsers in the dropdown. The old “GET request in background” toggle now lives here too, tucked away for power users.

⬇️ Profiles just got smarter
Importing profiles from Marketplace? Stream Deck 6.9 now helps you hit the ground running. If a profile uses actions from plugins you don’t have, you’ll be prompted to install them automatically—no guesswork, no more question marks.
Note: This only applies to profiles created with Stream Deck 6.9 or later.*

🪄 Quality of life improvements
A few small touches make a big difference:
- Option to launch Stream Deck on startup
- Option to disable automatic update checks
- macOS only: Stream Deck now appears in the Dock when open
- macOS only: You can now maximize the app using the green button

🛠️ Bug fixes and performance improvements
- Streamlabs Desktop actions are now a plugin. When you update to 6.9, these actions may show a ❓ until you install the new plugin. Don’t worry—your settings will be preserved.
- Fixed a bug where the Open action wouldn’t work on USB drives after replugging.

What’s new in Stream Deck 6.8.1?

This update enhances Elgato Marketplace connectivity and requires you to sign in again. After updating to Stream Deck 6.8, please log in to Marketplace to continue automatic plugin updates.

🆕 Action Sharing
Have you ever wanted to share a single action with a friend or colleague? Well, now you can. With Action Sharing, you can export an action from Stream Deck and share it like any other file. You can share key and dial actions, folders, Multi Actions, and more.
Exporting an action is easy—drag an action from a key or dial onto your desktop or into a folder, or right-click and select “Export”.
When someone sends you an action, drag the action from your file manager directly onto a key, or right-click on a key and select “Import”.

Learn more about Action Sharing.

🆕 Action Trigger for Stream Deck +
Turn up the power of your dials to 11! See what we did there? Put simply, Action Triggers enable you to assign key actions to dials, and trigger those actions with a clockwise turn, counterclockwise turn, or dial press. So any plugin and action can work with the dials, even if they don’t have built-in dial support!

Learn more about Action Trigger.

🛠️ Performance improvements & bug fixes
- Reworked Open Action: Improved handling of opening windows in the foreground (Windows). Note: Behavior may vary depending on the app and system.
- Added Traditional Chinese localization
- The update window text now appears correctly in inverted color when the operating system is set to dark mode
- The Auto Folder Exit time appears correctly
- Fixed an issue where opening Marketplace displayed a false error message about network connectivity
- Improved the YouTube account connection and reliability
- Improved the Twitch account connection and reliability
- Fixed an issue that messed up text colors when in dark mode
- Fixed a bug that could cause Stream Deck to crash when copying and pasting pages (Windows).
- Resolved an issue where plugins were unable to display images from certain file paths.
- Improved crash reporting on macOS to better diagnose crash-related issues.
